author: Eternaleaf
body:
Username: Eternaleaf

I was banned for hacking on April 18, 2015.

Yes I did Hack, but I understand my punishment and wish to get back on the server.
I will never Hack again, and If I do, I understand I will be banned forever.

The reason I want to get back on this server is because of the great mini-games this server features.
I have been playing on this server for a long time, since this server as known as play.mczone.
I played on a different account named ' Paulkimd ' and always played Nebula. 

I wish to be unbanned so I can enjoy this amazing server. I was banned for hacking
and I can promise on this server I will never do it again.

Thanks You for reading this.

Eternaleaf

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello, 

Unfortunately, I have decided to deny your appeal because your ban is quite recent, it will not be appealed until you have served a significant amount of time being banned.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
